prompt:
Image 1 is the camera and pose guide: a grey clay maquette rendered from the game's battle camera, with the leaf mantle painted in the god's colour. Copy from it exactly the camera angle, the direction the figure faces, its pose, and its size and place in the frame. Do not copy its smooth clay surfaces, its simplified shapes or the thickness of its limbs: the anatomy, the face and every ornament follow Image 2 and the description.
Image 2 is this god's own approved painted portrait: paint the same figure, with the same shapes, colours, materials and marks, now seen full length from above at the battle camera, in the same painting style. Do not copy its dark background, its candlelight or its framing.

One large painted figure, full length, alone in the image on a perfectly flat, uniform pure magenta (#FF00FF) background, as a game cutout. Pose: standing at rest, the leaf-bladed spear held upright in the right hand with its butt on the ground, the left arm at the side.

Camera: high above and in front, looking down at about 40 degrees, the way a player looks down at a miniature on a table; orthographic, with no perspective. The figure faces toward us and toward the lower left of the image: we see its face from above, its chest and its left side. It is foreshortened as seen from above: the top of its head, its shoulders and its upper body are large, its legs short.

Light: outdoor daylight; the figure stays as dark and as muted as in its portrait, lit only by small warm and cool highlights, never washed out or brightened. A high sun in the upper left of the image lights the top of the head, the upper surfaces and the upper-left side of the figure with warm highlights; a cool blue-grey sky fill lies in the shadows on the lower-right side. No candlelight, no dramatic dark shadows, nothing glows unless the description below says so. No cast shadow on the background.

Painting style: painterly oil on a wood panel, visible directional brushwork, moderate detail, the same hand as the painted portrait; a muted earthy palette with the god's own colours as its portrait shows them, in which the leaf mantle in deep bottle green, the green of jade in shade (#1F6A50), the Thornwood's colour is the one clear hue; soft painterly edges, with small crisp highlights on metal edges and a thin bright rim of light along the upper-left edges of the figure. The figure has a strong, simple, readable silhouette that still reads when it is shrunk to 120 pixels tall. It is not a cartoon: no cel shading, no thick black outlines, no chibi or big-headed proportions, no glossy 3D render, no pixel art.

The god: the Horned Hunter, a towering hunter-god who calls the wolves to the hunt, twice a man's height. Colours: muted and earthy. The one clear colour of the figure is its leaf mantle: cloth of a deep bottle green, the green of jade in shade, clearly coloured, never grey, slate, olive or yellow-green (#1F6A50), the Thornwood's colour. All metal is dull old gold (#C9A23E), darkened and worn. Nothing in the image glows. No other saturated area larger than a small clasp or trim.
Headgear: tall branching antlers growing from its brow. Face: a lean, fierce, bearded face; its skin is a deep brown like hide (#7A5638), painted with stripes of lichen grey-green (#909080) warpaint across the eyes and down the cheeks, the arms and the chest. Body: a powerful, lean body wearing a kilt and leggings of dark leather. Mantle: a long mantle of overlapping cloth leaves over the shoulders and down the back, cloth of a deep bottle green, the green of jade in shade, clearly coloured, never grey, slate, olive or yellow-green (#1F6A50), the Thornwood's colour. Weapon: a tall hunting spear with a long leaf-shaped blade of dull old gold (#C9A23E), darkened and worn on a dark ash-wood shaft. Proportions: tall and heroic, a towering figure with long legs (the legs about half of its height) and the head about one eighth of its height; never squat, stocky, short-legged or dwarf-like.

Size: the figure fills about 86% of the image along its longest side, placed as in Image 1, with at least 24 pixels of clean background all around; nothing is cropped.

Background: one flat pure magenta (#FF00FF) colour fills the whole image with no gradient, texture, floor, vignette or shadow. No pink, purple or magenta anywhere on the figure: no pink cloth, no pink glow, no pink reflections; its greens stay green.

Never: text, letters, numbers, labels, grid lines, borders, frames, signatures, logos; a floor, ground, scenery or cast shadows; blood; other creatures or people; a cropped figure; smoke, flames, sparks, floating embers or mist.
